summary: #smallpoems Viscous Forces resistant to porous courses sins of past cast a pitch, a slow drip of progress yet fluidity fastest at the axis as distortion dries on walls of history Together We climb taller in action lacrimal ducts sponging tears of tyranny into a meniscus height climbing past surface tensions
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Viscous Forces
  resistant to
porous courses
sins of past
  cast a pitch, a
slow drip
of progress
yet fluidity
fastest
at the
  axis as
distortion dries
on walls of
  history
Together We
climb taller in
action
  lacrimal ducts
sponging tears
  of tyranny
into a
meniscus
height
  climbing
past surface
tensions
